findings.title: With `--start-hidden`, the window now appears on screen and is hidden only after it loads.
findings.body:
Before this change, `--start-hidden` never created or showed the window; the backend was initialized directly. Now `desktop.MainWindow` is always set, so the classic desktop lifetime shows it at startup. It is hidden only in the `Loaded` handler, which runs after the window has been shown and laid out.

At autostart, which is the main use of `--start-hidden`, the main window can briefly flash on screen and take focus before disappearing.

Fix: don't let the lifetime show the window when starting hidden. For example, skip assigning `MainWindow` until it is first shown, or set `ShowActivated=false` and `Opacity=0` before `Show`. Alternatively, hide it in an earlier hook such as `Opened` instead of `Loaded`.
